description: Check whether a brand name is free to register as a domain. Read-only. Returns JSON with one result per TLD (registered / available / unknown) — all TLDs are checked in parallel. Uses RDAP (the registry's own data, free, no key): 404 = not registered; 'unknown' = the TLD has no RDAP service. Covers .com/.io/.ai/.co/.app/.dev/.net/.org by default, or a custom TLD list. A free domain does NOT mean the trademark is clear, and a taken domain does not block the trademark — domains and trademarks are separate rights, so use screen_trademark for the trademark check.

name.description: Brand name, e.g. NOVABREW — the .com etc. are checked for this exact string

tlds.description: TLDs to check, without the dot. Default: com, io, ai, co, app, dev, net, org

name: check_domains
